title: 8.0 / Who to Contact
slide_intent: Make responsibility easy to locate so unresolved questions reach a person with the relevant role.
strategic_value: Named retail roles can give Spectrum’s contributors a clear route for resolving execution questions.
demonstration: A large section heading sits above a compact Retail Team list in two columns on the pale gradient field.
practical_value: Identify the kinds of roles a brand guide should name, while treating these 2017 personal contacts as archival.
